business_scope.primary_industry_name: Middle-Market Cross-Border Cross-Industry M&A Advisory Boutique

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Spain–China BIT (signed 14 February 2005, entered into force 1 May 2008)
Spain–United States Friendship, Navigation and Commerce Treaty instruments as supplemented by bilateral investment protection arrangements
OECD Model-based DTAs: Spain–China DTA (1990 as amended by 2018 protocol), Spain–United Kingdom DTA (1975 as amended), Spain–United States DTA (1990)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo, as amended; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo; Real Decreto 1671/2009 for the Single Electronic Window for Companies (CIRCE); Real Decreto-ley 7/2021 transposing EU AML Directives; Orden JUS/319/2018 on the Cooperation of the Registry of Beneficial Owners; Law 6/2023 on Central Registry of Beneficial Ownership; General Company Law (Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificado de estar al corriente de obligaciones tributarias) for each shareholder corporate entity
Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Association of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Companies Registry (Registro Mercantil) of origin jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for non-Hague Convention jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Identity pages and biometric signature page of passport or EU national identity document of each individual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing national authority (Dirección General de la Policía in Spain; foreign equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder notarial) for the incorporator or authorized representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Spanish Notary (Notario) for Spanish executed powers; foreign notary with apostille for foreign executed powers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and sworn translation into Spanish where applicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs against OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, Spanish Consejo de Ministros sanctions listings, EBA and Banco de España risk indicators; enhanced due diligence (DDED) and PEP status declaration under Article 14 of Ley 10/2010; ongoing transaction monitoring and five-year retention of records.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: CIRCE (Centro de Información y Red de Creación de Empresas) — the official electronic platform for incorporation and name clearance of Spanish companies through the Registro Mercantil Central; online name certification request retained at http://www.registradores.org and https://www.circe.es
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Spanish or any officially recognized language of Spain; if using foreign names, transliteration into Latin script is required and the name must be clearly identifiable and legally translatable into Spanish for registry purposes; all documentation filed with the Registro Mercantil must be in Spanish or accompanied by sworn Spanish translation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Caixa (previously reserved to savings banks upon banking authorization)
Asesor/a Financiero/a (requires CNMV financial consultancy authorization if used as core descriptor)
Corredor/a or Agente de Seguros (requires insurance distribution license)
Abogado/a (requires Colegio de Abogados membership if used in a legal services context)
M&A advisor terms that imply regulated investment services: 'Gestora', 'Patrimonio', 'Valores', 'Inversión Colectiva', 'Fondos de Inversión'
Reino de España, España, Unión Europea (requires ministerial authorization if included in a manner that might mislead as to official endorsement)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación) is rejected or denied, the Requestor may (i) within 20 working days from notification submit a written reconsideration to the Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Central) providing new name options or contesting conflicts under Article 406 of the Companies Regulation; (ii) in case of persistence, file a challenge with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (formerly DGRN) as an administrative appeal; (iii) alternatively reserve an alternative name through CIRCE; each rejection requires a new certification fee of approximately EUR 10–15 and the appeal itself bears no separate statutory fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable as initial address only if the virtual office provider maintains a genuine physical office in Spain with documented lease, administrative staff, and mail handling; under Article 9 and 10 of Law 14/2013 (Startup Law) and general registry practice, the registered address must be a real operating or constituted address where the administrator can be found; for an M&A advisory boutique, a virtual-only address without local personnel is not permissible and creates a presumption of improper corporate substance for AML and tax residence purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 35% — quantified risk of unannounced on-site inspection by Registro Mercantil, Agencia Tributaria, or SEPBLAC (Servicio Ejecutivo de la Comisión de Prevención del Blanqueo de Capitales), particularly where no permanent office space is leased, no local employees are registered, or the company is classified as an M&A advisory intermediary with a Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML tier; medium incidence within first 18 months of operation and elevated during registration of appointment of administrators.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filing to the Central Mercantile Registry for name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff pursuant to the scale of the Registradores de España

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Spanish authenticated company incorporation deed (escritura pública) prepared by a Notary including legal review of corporate by-laws (estatutos), synchronizing capital subscription and shareholder identification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish Notary in the city where incorporation is filed (e.g., Madrid, Barcelona)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff (arancel notarial) ranging USD 700–1,200 for standard SL; market benchmark for an SL with two shareholders and standard clauses

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Settlement of capital tax (ITP-AJD) on incorporation at rate of 0.75% on the nominal capital contribution, making the corporate contribution to the Tax Agency (AEAT)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory rate under the consolidated text of the Reglamento del Impuesto sobre Transmisiones Patrimoniales y Actos Jurídicos Documentados sanctioned by the Comunitat Autònoma ... — applied by AEAT as competent collection body; assumed for EUR 10,000 (approx USD 12,000) capital contribution at 0.75%

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Fee for CIRCE issuance of electronic certificate of incorporation (certificado de inscripción) and processing via the Single Electronic Window (SUE)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: CIRCE and Consejo General del Notariado
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: CIRCE fixed electronic processing fee and notarial electronic certification fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration with the provincial Mercantile Registry after CIRCE approval (inscripción en el Registro Mercantil) covering fees for the company name, bylaws, and appointment of administrators
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Mercantile Registry fee schedule (arancel del Registro Mercantil) dependent on nominal capital and number of filing entries; estimate at statutory minimum bracket for SL with EUR 10,000 capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Appointment of tax address (domicilio fiscal) notification and filing of the NIF (CIF) permanent identification number with AEAT (Form 036)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee; Form 036 submitted electronically; costs absorbed by internal counsel/accountant

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory UBO registration filing with the Single Digital Window / Central Beneficial Ownership Registry under Law 6/2023
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro de Titularidades Reales, Ministerio de Justicia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Filing service fee and sworn administrative handling; no fixed statutory charge, but market processing fee for filing the beneficial ownership declaration through the electronic registry after company registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostilles and sworn translation of foreign-issued due diligence bundle (passports, foreign certificates, powers of attorney) into Spanish
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish Notary and certified translator (traductor jurado)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-sheet apostille fee in originating state (approx USD 15–25) plus Spanish sworn translation tariff of approx USD 30–50 per page; lump-sum estimate for three integration documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Administrative compliance advisory fee from external Spanish counsel covering UBO piercing, OFAC/UN/EU/SEPBLAC PEP and sanctions screening reports, AML internal policy drafting aligned with Ley 10/2010, and corporate administrator risk assessments
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for boutique corporate compliance: hourly blended rate (approx EUR 120–180/hour, estimated 10–14 hours) for enhanced due diligence, internal risk classification independent per company policy

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: MBR (Mercantile and tax) fiscal representation service for UBO screening, ongoing AML watchlist monitoring and matter-specific KYC controls — if retained for pre-incorporation only
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Not applicable at Stage 1 unless the client elects ongoing administration; quoted separately at market rates

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (Consolidated Text of the Spanish Capital Companies Act), Articles 20, 21, 22, 23, 62, 112, 175, 210 to 229 and 266; Royal Decree 1784/1996 (Commercial Registry Regulations); Law 14/2013 (entrepreneur support) for the DUE/CIRCE electronic procedure.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central for name certification and Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province where the registered office is established; notarial deed executed before a Spanish Notario; CIRCE/CREyS electronic window as the single point of entry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura de Constitución (public deed of incorporation), followed by the hoja registral inscription in the Commercial Registry; the company acquires legal personality only upon registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: SL minimum share capital is €3,000 (Article 4 of RDL 1/2010), fully subscribed and paid-up in cash or in-kind at incorporation; the capital deposit must be certified by a Spanish credit institution (certificado de depósito), and is released upon registration; no separate escrow agent is required for the formation stage.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING BOARD OF [COMPANY NAME], SL: The subscribers and founding directors, acting unanimously, resolve: (1) to ratify the subscription and full payment of the share capital of €3,000 divided into 3,000 indivisible quotas of €1 par value, certified by the deposit certificate issued by Banco [X]; (2) to adopt as the registered office Calle [address], Madrid, within Spanish territory, where corporate records and legal notifications shall be kept; (3) to appoint [Name] as sole Managing Director with full corporate, banking, and representation powers; (4) to authorize the Managing Director to execute all filings before the Commercial Registry, AEAT, SEPBLAC, and municipal authorities and to implement the AML compliance regime required by Law 10/2010. Adopted and signed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social (Negative Company Name Certification)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central via the CIRCE electronic portal or the RMC in-person service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal application listing up to three proposed corporate names in priority order through the CIRCE online form; pay the official certification fee; obtain the negative certification evidencing that no identical or confusingly similar company name is registered; the certificate is valid for three months and must accompany the deed.
required_dossiers: Official name-application form (solicitud de certificación)
Identification of the promoter (DNI/NIE/passport)
Proof of payment of the RMC certification fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is coincident or confusingly similar, immediately submit the next ranked alternative within the same application; if the RMC returns a negative (denegatoria) certification, refile a fresh application with distinctive corporate suffixes and await a new certification before the previous certificate expires.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Restricted Bank Account and Deposit of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any Spanish credit institution authorized by the Banco de España
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the name of the company in formation, deposit the minimum share capital of €3,000, and obtain a certificate of deposit (certificado de depósito) stating the subscribed quotas, depositors, and amount; the certificate is mandatory for the notarial deed and will be released by the bank after registration.
required_dossiers: Certificación negativa de denominación
Identity documents of all subscribing shareholders
Provisional corporate bylaws or draft deed
AML/KYC information of ultimate beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank delays the account opening, select an alternative authorized credit institution; no regulatory veto applies unless the bank files a suspicious transaction report under Law 10/2010, in which case restructure the ownership and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Deed of Incorporation before a Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario appointed in the province of the proposed registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the negative name certificate, bank deposit certificate, signed bylaws (estatutos), and the personal identification of all incorporating shareholders before the chosen notary; the notary verifies legal capacity, drafts the Escritura de Constitución, obtains the provisional NIF (CIF) from AEAT, and notarizes the deed with compulsory legal clauses.
required_dossiers: Certificación negativa de denominación social
Certificado de depósito bancario / in-kind valuation report
Estatutos sociales signed by all subscribers
Passport or residence permits of all shareholders and directors
Statement of ultimate beneficial owners and AML source of funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary observes defects in the company's object clause or capital, amend the bylaws and re-execute the deed at the same act; if the notary refuses due to AML doubts, provide documentary source-of-funds evidence and reapply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Provisional NIF, Tax Census Filing, and Stamp Duty Settlement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) — State Tax Administration Agency and the Regional Tax Office of the Autonomous Community
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary obtains the provisional NIF automatically; within thirty days after execution, file Form 036/037 with AEAT census data (registered office, director identities, activity code ISIC 7020); settle the Actos Jurídicos Documentados stamp duty (0.75%-1.5% depending on the autonomous community) on the first copy of the notarial matrix before presenting the deed to the Commercial Registry.
required_dossiers: First copy of the Escritura de Constitución
Formulario 036 / 037 de declaración censal
NIF provisional issued by AEAT
Payment receipt of the regional stamp duty (AJD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT notifies a census-data defect, submit a corrective Form 036 electronically; the provisional NIF remains effective until registration; if the regional tax office assesses excess AJD, file an appeal (recurso de reposición) before the autonomous taxation body within one month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial corresponding to the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the first copy of the notarial deed, together with proof of AJD payment and the provisional NIF, at the competent Provincial Commercial Registry within eight weeks of notarization; the registrar examines the legality of the deed, issues the definitive inscription (hoja registral), and thereby confers full legal personality on the company.
required_dossiers: Primera copia de la Escritura de Constitución
Certificado del NIF provisional
Justificante de liquidación del ITP-AJD
Notarial authorization or power of attorney if filed through an agent
Annual accounts opening balance sheet if foreign shareholders are involved
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a negative qualification (calificación negativa), cure the stated defect within the statutory sixty-day period by executing a complementary deed or supplying missing documents; if the defect persists, lodge a gubernativo appeal before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública, followed by judicial action in the civil courts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive NIF, Employer Registration, and Municipal Operating Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: AEAT; Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS); and the local city council of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon Commercial Registry inscription, request the definitive CIF at AEAT using the registration certificate; register the company as an employer with TGSS and obtain an employer contribution account before any hiring; file the local establishment declaration (Declaración responsable / Licencia de apertura) with the city council, together with fire and occupational health dossiers, to lawfully commence office operations.
required_dossiers: Certificado de inscripción registral (hoja registral)
Escritura de constitución fully registered
Provisional NIF
Lease agreement of the registered office
Municipal declaración responsable de apertura and fire safety certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the definitive NIF application is delayed, AEAT may require documentary verification of the registered office; attend with the lease agreement, utility invoices, and the Commercial Registry certificate; if TGSS rejects the employer code, correct the corporate identifying data and resubmit the F-036 declaration electronically.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Servicio Ejecutivo de la Comisión de Prevención del Blanqueo de Capitales e Infracciones Monetarias (SEPBLAC) under Banco de España supervision, together with the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Business for obliged-entity registration; the municipal council for the activity licence; no industrial manufacturing authority applies to an office-based advisory boutique.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Statutory registration as an obliged entity under Law 10/2010 on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, coupled with the municipal Licencia de Actividad / Declaración Responsable de Apertura (local establishment operating permit); no sectoral investment-services licence is required for pure M&A advisory where no investment advice or order execution is provided, but corporate-finance advisory triggers AML registration.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITECO) and the competent regional environmental authority of the Autonomous Community of Madrid or the province of the registered office
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the activity is a dry-advisory urban office not listed in Annexes I or II of Law 21/2013 on environmental impact assessment; only a municipal environmental integration check applies to the opening of office premises, with no full EIA report or registration required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC discharge points; only domestic-office sewage subject to municipal sewerage ordinances (typically BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L, COD ≤ 500 mg/L, TSS ≤ 350 mg/L); negligible VOC or particle emissions; indoor climate and ventilation per RITE/CTE; electronic waste and toner cartridges must be transferred to authorized waste managers (gestor de residuos) under Law 7/2022 on waste and contaminated soils.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety compliance under Real Decreto 2267/2004 for fire-protection installations in non-industrial premises, including portable extinguishers, emergency lighting, and emergency exits; a structural-load certificate per CTE-DB-SE where any server room or heavy archive equipment is installed; occupational health and safety assessment under Law 31/1995 (Prevención de Riesgos Laborales), including the appointment of a prevention service, workplace risk evaluation, employee health surveillance, and registration of the centro de trabajo with the competent labor authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), operating through the Sede Electrónica de la Agencia Tributaria. Regional tax authorities administer certain taxes in the Basque Country and Navarra under their respective Economic Agreement regimes; an entity resident in ordinary Spanish territory generally registers with AEAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada obtains a Spanish Número de Identificación Fiscal (NIF) through AEAT using Form Modelo 036. A provisional NIF may be requested after execution of the incorporation documents and before registration in the Commercial Registry; the definitive NIF must be obtained after registration, generally by filing the registry documentation and updated corporate particulars. A foreign shareholder or foreign corporate director requiring Spanish tax identification must obtain an NIF, normally by filing Modelo 036 through an authorized representative, Spanish consulate, or AEAT office, with legalized or apostilled constitutional documents, official Spanish translation where required, evidence of existence and address, identification of the legal representative, and power of attorney. The company must use its NIF on invoices, tax returns, banking and commercial documentation. Registration in the Registro de Operadores Intracomunitarios (ROI) and activation of the VIES status are requested through Modelo 036 where intra-EU supplies or acquisitions are expected. VAT registration must be completed before commencing taxable activities or making the relevant intra-EU transactions; there is no general low-value exemption that postpones registration for an SL carrying on an economic activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not operate a general United States-style check-the-box election for an SL. A Spanish SL is ordinarily subject to Spanish Corporate Income Tax as a separate legal person. Available elective or qualifying regimes may include the consolidated tax group regime, the VAT group regime, the cash-collection VAT regime where statutory conditions are met, the ETVE regime for qualifying foreign shareholdings, the SOCIMI regime for qualifying listed real-estate companies, and other expressly regulated special regimes. Anti-hybrid mismatch rules under the Corporate Income Tax Law restrict deductions, impose inclusion outcomes, or deny relief for arrangements involving hybrid instruments, hybrid entities, imported mismatches, or branches. Election deadlines, ownership tests, substance requirements, and notification obligations must be reviewed for the specific regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido, IVA), with Spanish VAT rules based principally on Law 37/1992. The Canary Islands, Ceuta, and Melilla are outside the territorial scope of Spanish VAT and have separate indirect-tax systems.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None. Spain has no general domestic VAT turnover threshold below which a business may remain unregistered. A person carrying on an economic activity must register before commencing the activity or making relevant taxable transactions. Separate registration or reporting can be triggered by intra-EU transactions, imports, distance sales, platform transactions, or special regimes. The €10,000 EU-wide threshold for certain intra-EU consumer distance sales and electronically supplied services is not a general Spanish VAT-registration threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Spain does not currently impose a universal real-time pre-clearance requirement for every invoice. The Immediate Supply of Information system (Suministro Inmediato de Información, SII) requires qualifying taxpayers, including taxpayers with turnover above €6 million, VAT groups, and entities in the REDEME monthly refund regime, to transmit specified invoice-register data electronically to AEAT, generally within four business days, subject to statutory exceptions. Royal Decree 1007/2023 establishes requirements for computerized invoicing and billing systems, including integrity, conservation, traceability, accessibility, and anti-alteration controls, with the VERI*FACTU reporting model. The implementation timetable has been amended by subsequent legislation and must be confirmed at the filing date. The Corporate Information Society Law framework also provides for mandatory electronic invoicing between businesses and professionals, subject to implementing regulations and phased effective dates. A Spanish M&A advisory SL should maintain compliant digital invoice records, electronic signatures or equivalent authenticity controls, audit trails, and AEAT-compatible data exports; it should not assume that every invoice requires prior digital stamping or real-time clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods dispatched from Spanish VAT territory to a destination outside the European Union may qualify for exemption with a right to deduct input VAT where the supplier or an appointed intermediary completes the export and retains evidence of customs exit. Intra-EU supplies of goods may qualify for exemption where the customer is identified for VAT in another Member State, the goods are dispatched to that Member State, and the supplier satisfies invoicing, VIES validation, and recapitulative statement requirements. Services supplied to a business established outside Spain generally follow the B2B place-of-supply rule and are outside the scope of Spanish VAT when the customer is established outside Spanish VAT territory; this is not technically a Spanish zero-rated supply. Certain services connected with exports, international transport, and transactions outside the EU may qualify for specific exemptions. M&A advisory services require a transaction-by-transaction analysis, including customer status, place of establishment, fixed establishments, actual use and enjoyment rules, and any connection with exempt financial or securities transactions. Input VAT refunds require valid invoices, business-use evidence, proper accounting, and compliance with the applicable domestic or non-established-taxpayer refund procedure.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic export declaration filed through the customs system, including the Movement Reference Number (MRN)
Customs release and exit confirmation, such as the electronic exit results or equivalent customs evidence
Commercial invoice and export contract or order documentation
Packing list and transport documentation, including bill of lading, airway bill, or road consignment note where applicable
Evidence identifying the goods, exporter, consignee, destination outside the EU, and transport route
Proof of payment or accounting records supporting the transaction where relevant to audit substantiation
For intra-EU exempt supplies: customer VAT identification number, transport evidence, and correct recapitulative statement reporting
An inward remittance certificate is not a general Spanish VAT condition for export exemption; banking evidence may nevertheless support the commercial and audit record
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Spain has no general statutory requirement that export proceeds be repatriated within 180 days. AEAT may deny or reverse an exemption where customs exit, transport, customer status, place-of-supply, or accounting evidence is incomplete or contradictory. The resulting VAT, statutory late-payment interest, and applicable penalties may be assessed retrospectively, subject to limitation periods and procedural rules. Tax penalties may generally range from 50% to 100% of the unpaid tax for serious infringements and from 100% to 150% for very serious infringements, with the precise percentage depending on concealment, fraud, repetition, document falsification, or other statutory aggravating factors. Incorrect VAT invoicing or failure to maintain required records may attract separate fixed or proportional penalties. Deliberate tax fraud exceeding the criminal threshold of EUR 120,000 for a tax period may constitute a criminal offense, with potential fines and imprisonment for responsible individuals. Customs infringements may produce additional duties, penalties, seizure, or loss of customs simplifications. Voluntary correction, cooperation, effective restitution, and compliant documentary retention may reduce or mitigate penalties where legally available.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Spain (Banco de España) acting within the European System of Central Banks (ESCB); monetary and exchange-rate policy is reserved to the European Central Bank (ECB) per Articles 127-133 TFEU. Foreign investment screening is administered by the Directorate-General for International Trade and Investment (DGCIIN) of the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Enterprise, and AML supervisory enforcement is exercised by SEPBLAC (Servicio Ejecutivo de la Comisión de Prevención de Blanqueo de Capitales e Infracciones Monetarias) under Law 10/2010.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain is a euro-area Member State with full current-account and capital-account convertibility under Article 63 TFEU and Law 19/2003 on Foreign Investment. There are no exchange controls, no prior authorisations, and no limits on profit repatriation or dividend remittance for EU/EEA investors. Non-EU/EFTA investments in critical sectors (defence, dual-use items, critical energy, communications, data infrastructure, media, and sensitive technology) are subject to ex-ante screening when the investor acquires control (generally >10% voting rights or decisive influence) or, in specified sensitive sectors, when the gross transaction value equals or exceeds EUR 500 million, pursuant to Law 8/2020 and Royal Decree 571/2023. Dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders are freely remittable via banking channels but attract a 19% statutory Spanish withholding tax, reducible to 10%, 5%, or 0% under the applicable double tax treaty (e.g., Spain-Latin America conventions); no central bank 'good leave' certificate or tax clearance certificate is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. Spain imposes no mandatory surrender, conversion, or repatriation of export proceeds or service-fee receivables; invoicing in EUR or any foreign currency is unrestricted. However, statistical balance-of-payments reporting to the Bank of Spain applies to all residents: any single cross-border transaction equal to or exceeding EUR 50,000 (or cumulative monthly transactions reaching that threshold) must be declared on the official 'Declaración de Operaciones' (balance-of-payments statistical form) within the reporting month. Additionally, cash movements into or out of the EU in excess of EUR 10,000 require a written customs declaration under Regulation (EU) 2018/1672, and business-related cash payments exceeding EUR 100,000 are prohibited under Law 10/2010 (Article 34).

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: MEDIUM as a supplementary SEPA/EUR collection rail; LOW as the sole treasury infrastructure. Authorised equity is EUR 18,300 (0.9% paid) and registration in the Registro Mercantil is required. For the escrow of M&A success fees, a credit institution (bank) is mandatory because Spanish EMIs cannot take deposits, hold third-party escrow balances, or provide FX hedging; only licensed EDEs (entidades de dinero electrónico) may issue e-money and execute payment transactions. Offshore/EEA EMIs must passport into Spain under the EU e-money regime; UK-based EMIs lost passporting rights post-Brexit and require a Spanish branch authorisation or an EEA-licensed entity. Counterparty and safeguarding risk renders the boutique's Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML profile incompatible with fintech-only holding of client consideration.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Spanish tier-1 commercial banks generally require at least one director or authorised signatory to attend an onboarding interview in person at the branch where the operational account is domiciled. Remote video-KYC onboarding is available at some institutions for simple structures, but it is discretionary and typically refused for Medium_Risk_Enhanced M&A advisory firms, for which the bank requires a physical signature session. If the SL has no Spanish-resident director, the bank accepts a notarised and apostilled Spanish power of attorney (poder notarial) granted to a local attorney-in-fact, together with the SL's deed of incorporation, NIF certificate, and a certified registry certificate from the Registro Mercantil. Dual-control instructions (two approvers) and the physical issuance of PKI tokens (electronic signatures) generally necessitate one in-person visit. Plan for a 1-3 week onboarding period with at least two branch visits for escalations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) chain opacity: shareholders are holding companies incorporated in low-tax jurisdictions (e.g., Delaware, Panama, Netherlands) with nominee directors or unadjudicated share registers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Consolidated UBO disclosure per Law 10/2010 (identification of every natural person with >25% interest); notarised and apostilled share registers; original share transfer agreements; Registro Mercantil certificates; sworn source-of-wealth statements for each UBO; certification that no nominee/non-natural person conceals the beneficial owner; EU/UN sanctions screening output for all UBOs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction exposure: success fees originate from Latin American or Caribbean counterparties, including PEP-related entities, or counterparties based in FATF-listed jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed engagement letters detailing cross-border M&A advisory services (ISIC 7020 / NAICS 523150); copy of the CNMV registration or ministerial exemption letter confirming the statutory investment-services licence; original invoices and closing statements; SAR/STR clearance certificate; PEP status declaration and risk-rating memo; evidence of enhanced due diligence performed on the client; sworn declaration of non-criminal provenance of funds under Law 10/2010.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disbursement to unknown third parties: the SL instructs split payments of a success fee to multiple external advisors or intermediaries without a disclosed contractual nexus.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tripartite or consortium agreements listing each beneficiary with full legal identity and tax residence; detailed fee-sharing schedules and basis of calculation; copies of MT103 payment trails; each beneficiary's NIF/equivalent tax identification certificate; board resolution of the SL approving the treasury distribution; sworn statements of the disposing parties confirming the non-existence of money laundering.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual transaction velocity: multiple high-value (EUR 500,000+) inbound wires and immediate onward distributions within the first six months of account operation, triggering STR suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Annual treasury and liquidity policy approved by the SL's board; internal AML/CFT procedures manual with escalation thresholds; source-of-funds documents (shareholder loan agreements, share premium entries, closing statements); bank statements of the originating entities; pre-notification of large transfers in writing; minutes of the compliance committee authorising each treasury operation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity injections or shareholder loans must be routed by SWIFT MT103/MT103 STP (for USD/GBP/other currencies) or SEPA Credit Transfer (for EUR) to the SL's designated operational account at an authorised Spanish credit institution. The payment reference must clearly indicate the transaction nature: 'Capital Increase - Escritura No. X' for registered share subscriptions, or 'Prestamo Socios' for shareholder advances, with the supporting corporate resolution and notarial deed submitted to the bank before value date. Statutory compliance: (i) each inbound transaction >= EUR 50,000 must be reported to the Bank of Spain under the balance-of-payments statistical regime (form 'Declaración de Operaciones') within the month; (ii) a post-investment declaration to the Registry of Foreign Investments (Registro de Inversiones Exteriores) of the DGCIIN is mandatory for non-EU/EEA investors within 30 days of the capital increase, including investor identity, amount, and purpose; (iii) legalisation of funds is required for non-resident investors without Spanish NIF. Banks will require board resolution, updated books, and a certificate of inactivity/no AML flags from the remitting bank for any inbound sum above EUR 100,000.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Success-fee and advisory disbursements are cleared via: (i) SWIFT MT103 (single customer credit transfer) for cross-border payments in EUR, USD, GBP, or LATAM currencies, with strict referencing of the invoice and engagement letter; (ii) SEPA Credit Transfer (SEPA CT) and SEPA Instant for EU/EEA EUR payments; (iii) Commercial or Standby Letters of Credit (Documentary Credits under ICC UCP 600) exceptionally for structured deals where the buyer requires a bank undertaking for deferred payment or earn-out milestones; (iv) domestic transfers via the Spanish retail payment system in EUR to local beneficiaries. No FX authorisation is required, but every outbound transfer >= EUR 50,000 triggers the Bank of Spain statistical declaration, and any cash component above EUR 10,000 is unlawful and must be refused. For USD-denominated success-fee settlements, the bank may require a tax certificate (modelo 296/193) for non-resident payees or a WHT exemption certificate under the applicable treaty.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forwards (Outright Forwards) - OTC, executed with authorised Spanish credit institutions (e.g., EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CHF, EUR/MXN, EUR/BRL) under ISDA Master Agreement and Credit Support Annex; fully permissible for hedging forecast fee income without MiFID II classification because the SL hedges its own treasury exposure.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) - for currencies with onshore transfer restrictions or limited deliverability in the Spanish interbank market (e.g., USD/CLP, USD/COP, USD/PEN, USD/ARS), offered by large international banks resident in Spain or via EU branches; subject to internal credit limits and must be macro-hedged against specific invoice-level exposure.
FX Swaps (Swap de Divisas) - including spot/forward rollovers and forward/forward swaps used to manage short-term liquidity positions in multi-currency operational accounts.

Cross-Currency Swaps (CCS) - permissible for long-term dollarised success-fee receivables or shareholder loans, exchanging EUR and USD fixed/floating interest streams with an authorised Spanish credit institution, with full ISDA documentation and regulatory capital implications assessed by the bank.

Currency Options (European-style Plain Vanilla FX Options) - available for contingent M&A fee flows where the closing probability is uncertain; purchased on a premium-paid basis to cap adverse EUR appreciation without obligations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Annual Accounts with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months following the end of the financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative sanctions including fines up to 300000 EUR and risk of administrative dissolution proceedings

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if the SL exceeds at least two of the following: net turnover > 2000000 EUR, total assets > 1000000 EUR, or average number of employees > 50
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (PGC) / Local GAAP

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No mandatory annual confirmation for shareholding transfers; beneficial ownership register must be updated within one month of any change

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 100-500 USD per annum for registered office or local agent services

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for first two years of taxable profits for entities with net turnover below €1 million; deductions for R&D&I (up to 42%), export activities, and reinvestment of extraordinary income; participation exemption for qualifying dividends and capital gains (95% exemption).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 200 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) filed electronically via the AEAT portal (Sede Electrónica).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 days following the 6th month after the fiscal year-end (e.g., for calendar year-end, by July 25).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number (NIF) of the entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the NIF assigned by the Spanish tax authorities; if not available, use the foreign tax ID and indicate the country.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year start and end dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Indicate the exact period covered by the return, typically 12 months.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net turnover (Importe Neto de la Cifra de Negocios).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross revenue from advisory services, including success fees, net of VAT and discounts.
Calculate after adjustments for permanent establishment (if applicable) and transfer pricing corrections.
Standard 25%; reduced 15% if eligible for new entity regime.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits and deductions (Deducciones y Bonificaciones).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim treaty relief, double tax credits, and R&D deductions with supporting documentation.
Net of withholdings and quarterly prepayments (pagos fraccionados).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: 5% of the tax due if filed within 3 months of deadline, increasing to 20% after 12 months; plus daily surcharge of €200 per day for delays exceeding 3 months. Interest of 3.75% per annum applies. Non-filing may result in a penalty of 50% of the tax due.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must submit a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the tax authority of the residence country, along with Form 210 (for non-resident income tax) or Form 216 (for withholding tax refund). The TRC must be apostilled or legalized and submitted to the Spanish paying agent or AEAT before the distribution date to apply the reduced treaty rate. Retroactive relief is possible via refund within 4 years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: Royalties 24%, Interest 19%. Treaty rates typically reduced to 0-10% for interest and 5-10% for royalties depending on the DTA (e.g., with EU/EEA countries often 0% for interest under EU Interest & Royalties Directive).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required if related-party transactions exceed €250,000 per year or if the entity's net turnover exceeds €10 million. Master File required for groups with consolidated turnover ≥ €50 million.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain does not have a formal ESR regime, but anti-abuse rules (e.g., general anti-avoidance rule, substance-over-form) apply. For M&A advisory, the entity must demonstrate adequate personnel, premises, and decision-making functions in Spain to avoid being deemed a shell company under the EU ATAD and Spanish tax law.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate underreporting of success fees, inflating deductible expenses, or using shell entities to shift profits to no-tax jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 50% to 150% of the evaded tax, plus interest. Criminal prosecution for amounts exceeding €120,000 per year may lead to imprisonment of 2-6 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be jointly and severally liable for unpaid corporate taxes if they knowingly participated in evasion. Travel bans and asset freezes may be imposed during investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without physical office, employees, or real business activity in Spain; using the SL as a conduit for cross-border M&A fees without substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reclassification of income as Spanish-source, disallowance of treaty benefits, and imposition of 25% corporate tax plus 19% dividend withholding on deemed distributions. Penalties up to 150% of the tax understated.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for unpaid taxes if they signed false declarations. In severe cases, criminal charges for fraud may result in imprisonment and travel bans.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to conduct customer due diligence on M&A counterparties, accepting cash payments above €10,000, or processing success fees from politically exposed persons without enhanced checks.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines from €60,001 to €5,000,000 for serious infractions under Law 10/2010. Criminal liability for money laundering (Art. 301 Penal Code) with imprisonment up to 6 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for AML compliance failures. They may face criminal prosecution, travel bans, and disqualification from holding directorships.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging non-arm's length success fees to related parties, failing to maintain contemporaneous TP documentation, or not filing Form 232 (related-party transactions) when thresholds are met.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP adjustment with penalty of 15% on the adjusted amount, plus late interest. If documentation is missing, penalty of €1,500 per data item (max €15,000).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false TP documentation may be held personally liable for penalties if they acted with intent or gross negligence.
